parts.name: Root
parts.description: State container for the popover. Shares open state, the trigger reference, and open/close/toggle actions with the trigger and content parts.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Reference to the trigger element. Can be set manually or via Popover.Trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Children (Trigger and Content)

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The floating role="dialog" panel, rendered in a portal and positioned against the trigger. Works inside Popover.Root or in standalone controlled mode via `open`, `triggerRef`, and `onOpenChange`.

props.name: offset
props.description: Offset along the main axis from the anchor element.

props.name: placement
props.description: Placement relative to the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Whether to flip when there's insufficient space.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: Boundary element for positioning constraints.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the popover.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description: Whether the popover is non-modal (allows outside interaction, no focus trap, no scroll lock).

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether clicking outside the popover should close it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape should close the popover.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Whether losing focus (blur) should close the popover. Defaults to true for non-modal popovers.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Element or selector to focus first when modal trap activates.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state (standalone mode).

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Reference to the trigger element (standalone mode).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes (standalone mode).

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-placement
dataAttributes.description: The resolved side of the trigger the panel is on ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left").

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the popover is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Button that registers itself as the popover trigger and toggles the popover on click (aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded).

props.name: children
props.description: Button content.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the button.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

parts.name: Overlay
parts.description: Optional backdrop rendered behind the popover. Place it as a sibling of Popover.Content inside Popover.Root; it runs its own enter/exit presence so it fades in step with the panel.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the overlay.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the popover is open, "closed" during exit.
